english.note: Use this for an unbroken line, run, or sequence with no intervening space or gap.
This is the all-purpose choice for things occurring in consecutive order, especially consecutive periods such as years or days.
Use 連續 before a number or event when straight means occurring consecutively without a break.
Use this when something proceeds continuously without a break or interruption.

examples.english: It rained for three continuous days, so I didn't even want to go out.
examples.traditional: 連續三日落雨，搞到我都唔想出街。
